message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.help.f: You would not feed us. We took it. Do not look like that.
Hungry. Your bag had meat. We ate.
We waited. We asked, in our way. Then we took.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.help.s: Something crawled near us. It does not now.
We do not like them on you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.help.o: There. In the stone. We took it.
Shine in the rock. We reached.
Ore. It was close, so we had it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.help.t: Dark. Your eyes are slow. We set a light.
A little fire for you. Stay near it.
You cannot see. We can. A torch, then.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.keep.t: This one is good. We will hold it, %s.
%s. Fine work. It stays with us a while.
We took %s. Do not worry. It is safe in us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.keep.b: You have kept your word. Here, %s.
Take it back, %s. We trust you more now.
%s. You may have it. We have held it enough.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.keep.p: You tore it out. We felt every inch.
It was ours to hold. You pulled.
Not yet. You took it before we gave it.
Something old and shut. We opened it for you.
A hidden box. Nobody had touched it. We have.
Treasure. We took it all. It is yours.
We looked in. There are things inside.
The box smells of leather and iron.
Nothing in it. How sad a box can be.
It was a mess. We put it in order.
We tidied the box. You are welcome.
We took %s. You will not miss it.
%s. We liked it. We kept it.
The box had %s. It has it no longer.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.molt.b: We itch. Our skin is too small. Stay close.
It pulls. Something is ending. Do not go far.
Today we shed. Stay near. Do not run.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.molt.i: We are tight. Be still, be near.
The skin is coming loose. Stay.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.molt.r: Slowly. We are thin all over.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.molt.c: It came away whole. You stayed. We are looser, and closer.
Done. The old skin lies there. Thank you for staying.
We are new. You were quiet beside us. We remember.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.molt.r: You ran. It tore as it came. We are sore.
We shed in a hurry. It hurts.
The old skin came off ragged. You were not here.
Too many. We will not be cornered. Open.
Let them see all of us.
We are empty. We open to feed on the air.
Feed us. We are open now.
We cannot hold it shut. It opens.
Too much. We open and we shake.
We are afraid. We do not hide it.
